testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect a part file before opening it ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a folder contains a saved part with a preview and metadata ✔ And the folder contains `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` with a saved preview and metadata ✔ When the user presses Control+O and navigates to that folder ✔ And the user selects the saved part ✔ Then the part row is selected and the file name field identifies it ✔ And the preview displays the part ✔ And the Options pane displays Model State and Design View controls ✔ When the user chooses Details ✔ Then the preview remains visible ✔ And the details include the file type, modification date, size, author and part number ✔ When the user cancels the Open dialog ✔ Then the previously active part document remains displayed
